title: Rav Tachlifa bar Avina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Rav Chisda, as in Chullin 60b, where Rav Chisda said to him: “Write kanini and balistri — arunki in your aggadah book, and explain it.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Chullin 60b has two instructions to Rav Tachlifa: write קניגי ובליסטרי and explain it, then write ארונקי and explain it. Hyman compresses them with a dash and supplies קניני rather than קניגי; the supplied form is retained without claiming a history of the letters.

The two whole selected Davidson Chullin 60b paragraphs have Rav Chisda instructing Rav Tachlifa bar Avina to write and explain, first קניגי ובליסטרי and then ארונקי. Hyman’s supplied קניני spelling and dash compressing the two instructions remain intact. His description “student of Rav Chisda” stays explicitly attributed, with no new teacher edge. The earlier mixed note remains verbatim; no printed letter or correction history is claimed.
